bullets.text: A youth from Cuddalore was murdered and buried at Ponneri beach in Thiruvallur, causing shock.
Two women were killed in separate bus crashes near Puzhal and Nazarethpet, leading police to arrest the drivers.
Unused wheelchairs meant for persons with disabilities are rusting and wasting government funds in Kadambathur.
The Greater Chennai Corporation plans a fresh feasibility study for a rope car service connecting Marina and Besant Nagar beaches.
Two female wardens in Chennai and Nagercoil were booked for allegedly harassing a plus-one student.
Police arrested three people in Gummidipoondi for issuing death threats to a sub-inspector during vehicle checks.
Southern Railway has revised suburban train services on multiple Chennai sections starting November 1.
A Panimalar Engineering College student from Poonamallee secured a job with a 1.2 crore rupee salary at Meryl Diagnostics.
The Tamil Nadu government allocated 125 crore rupees for a scheme providing AI assistive devices to persons with disabilities.
Larsen and Toubro broke ground on a new 52MW data center facility in Tamil Nadu through its cloud unit Vyoma.AI.
The Supreme Court directed MeitY to include penalties for the unauthorized circulation of live-streamed court proceedings.
The Tamil Nadu government approved 680 road projects including the beautification of the Gateway of Chennai costing 131 crore rupees.
Infosys expanded its Pocharam Development Center in Hyderabad by 1.1 million square feet, adding 10,000 new seats.
